setup: Pass 1 of the RX-port leakage measurement: TX LO-null biases at LMX drive 0 for LO 13.25-22.5 GHz (0.25 GHz steps), TX filter = optimal for an output 1 GHz above the LO. Case closed (shipped). FieldFox source OFF. TX-side FR3 RF Out -> FR3 cable -> FieldFox. 2LO is not read above 26.5 GHz.
readings: LO and 2LO at TX-side FR3 RF Out, FR3 cable corrected; 1 MHz span, RBW 10 kHz, 30 dB att, no averaging, peak search, continuous sweep ON
